name: vidlens
description: Video intelligence for Codex and MCP clients: search, import, index, and inspect video evidence with portable structured results.

interface.shortDescription: Search and index video as local assets
interface.longDescription: VidLens turns online and local videos into searchable local assets for AI agents. It supports YouTube plus universal video source ingestion through the same MCP server used by Claude and Codex, with yt-dlp downloads, ffmpeg frame extraction, Apple Vision OCR/similarity, optional Gemini descriptions and embeddings, and structured evidence that capable clients can present through their own native response surfaces.
defaultPrompt: Import this video and make it searchable
